integrity: The size bound has a direct projection proof. The finite equality census, affine classification, direction count, and orbit count are replayed from the bundled exact verifier.
scientific_limitations: Binary length 6 only; noncyclic adjacency; one burst of length at most 2; declared orbit action is translations plus reversal and is not claimed to be the full isometry group.
title: Equality cases for six-bit correction of one length-two burst
